responsibility: Provides the empty implementation module for ConvTypes, whose substantive role is the shared declaration of conversion result enums and scanner state types in ConvTypes.def. It exists as the implementation companion for the common typing layer used throughout gm2 numeric parsing and formatting code.
same_name_distinction: This file is only the empty implementation module paired with ConvTypes.def; unlike the definition file, it does not declare the shared conversion-result or scanner-control types.
